package.name: litegrip_ros2_control
package.description:
The ros2_control adapter layer for the LiteGrip gripper: a C++ SystemInterface plugin backed directly by the litegrip_cpp SDK.
The plugin is a thin shell. Everything that used to live in a separate Python hardware daemon — the trajectory rate ceiling, the torque budget, the red-line safety gate, the DM MIT frame stream and the feedback/temperature/ fault watchdogs — now lives inside litegrip_cpp::ControlLoop, on the SDK's own thread. There is no second process, no shared memory and no Python in the stack; this component only parses the URDF parameters, owns the loop's lifecycle, and converts between the ROS joint unit (opening in m) and the motor angle (rad) the SDK works in.
Interface surface (decided by the user on 2026-09-23, unchanged): **command exposes position only** (matching the arm joints, MIT position control underneath); **state exposes position/velocity/effort** (matching the arm joints) plus diagnostics.
